        else_if = { limit = { oe_tsn_theme_score_i3 >= 50 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryt add = 1 } } }
        else = { scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnt add = 1 } } }
    }
    oe_tsn_cap_prefecture = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryc value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnc value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryt value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnt value = 0 }
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_tsn_seated = yes oe_theme_in_prefecture_2 = yes }
        if = { limit = { oe_ts_charter = yes oe_tsn_theme_score_i3 >= 50 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryc add = 2 } } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ts_charter = yes } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnc add = 2 } } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_tsn_theme_score_i3 >= 50 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryt add = 1 } } }
        else = { scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnt add = 1 } } }
    }
    oe_tsn_cap_prefecture = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryc value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnc value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryt value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnt value = 0 }
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_tsn_seated = yes oe_theme_in_prefecture_3 = yes }
        if = { limit = { oe_ts_charter = yes oe_tsn_theme_score_i3 >= 50 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryc add = 2 } } }

    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_pvc3_yes_h value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_pvc3_no_h value = 0 }

# BYZ/ROM scope. Refreshes all 4 cached Senate preview tallies + seat count (called on game start, monthly, and post-vote).
oe_tsn_refresh_preview_cache = {
    oe_tsn_cache_issue_1 = yes
    oe_tsn_cache_issue_2 = yes
    oe_tsn_cache_issue_3 = yes
    oe_tsn_cache_issue_4 = yes
}

# Called by oe_tsn_request right after oe_tsn_count: refreshes and checks that the cached preview equals the live tally.
oe_tsn_pv_check = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tsn_pv_n } } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_pv_n value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tsn_pv_miss } } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_pv_miss value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 1 }
        oe_tsn_cache_issue_1 = yes
        change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_pv_n add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { oe_tsn_pv1_yes_c > var:oe_tsn_yes_c oe_tsn_pv1_yes_c < var:oe_tsn_yes_c oe_tsn_pv1_yes_t > var:oe_tsn_yes_t oe_tsn_pv1_yes_t < var:oe_tsn_yes_t oe_tsn_pv1_yes_h > var:oe_tsn_yes_h oe_tsn_pv1_yes_h < var:oe_tsn_yes_h oe_tsn_pv1_yes_o > var:oe_tsn_yes_o oe_tsn_pv1_yes_o < var:oe_tsn_yes_o oe_tsn_pv1_no_c > var:oe_tsn_no_c oe_tsn_pv1_no_c < var:oe_tsn_no_c oe_tsn_pv1_no_t > var:oe_tsn_no_t oe_tsn_pv1_no_t < var:oe_tsn_no_t oe_tsn_pv1_no_h > var:oe_tsn_no_h oe_tsn_pv1_no_h < var:oe_tsn_no_h oe_tsn_pv1_no_o > var:oe_tsn_no_o oe_tsn_pv1_no_o < var:oe_tsn_no_o } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_pv_miss add = 1 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 2 }
        oe_tsn_cache_issue_2 = yes
        change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_pv_n add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { oe_tsn_pv2_yes_c > var:oe_tsn_yes_c oe_tsn_pv2_yes_c < var:oe_tsn_yes_c oe_tsn_pv2_yes_t > var:oe_tsn_yes_t oe_tsn_pv2_yes_t < var:oe_tsn_yes_t oe_tsn_pv2_yes_h > var:oe_tsn_yes_h oe_tsn_pv2_yes_h < var:oe_tsn_yes_h oe_tsn_pv2_yes_o > var:oe_tsn_yes_o oe_tsn_pv2_yes_o < var:oe_tsn_yes_o oe_tsn_pv2_no_c > var:oe_tsn_no_c oe_tsn_pv2_no_c < var:oe_tsn_no_c oe_tsn_pv2_no_t > var:oe_tsn_no_t oe_tsn_pv2_no_t < var:oe_tsn_no_t oe_tsn_pv2_no_h > var:oe_tsn_no_h oe_tsn_pv2_no_h < var:oe_tsn_no_h oe_tsn_pv2_no_o > var:oe_tsn_no_o oe_tsn_pv2_no_o < var:oe_tsn_no_o } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_pv_miss add = 1 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 3 }
        oe_tsn_cache_issue_3 = yes
        change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_pv_n add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { oe_tsn_pv3_yes_c > var:oe_tsn_yes_c oe_tsn_pv3_yes_c < var:oe_tsn_yes_c oe_tsn_pv3_yes_t > var:oe_tsn_yes_t oe_tsn_pv3_yes_t < var:oe_tsn_yes_t oe_tsn_pv3_yes_h > var:oe_tsn_yes_h oe_tsn_pv3_yes_h < var:oe_tsn_yes_h oe_tsn_pv3_yes_o > var:oe_tsn_yes_o oe_tsn_pv3_yes_o < var:oe_tsn_yes_o oe_tsn_pv3_no_c > var:oe_tsn_no_c oe_tsn_pv3_no_c < var:oe_tsn_no_c oe_tsn_pv3_no_t > var:oe_tsn_no_t oe_tsn_pv3_no_t < var:oe_tsn_no_t oe_tsn_pv3_no_h > var:oe_tsn_no_h oe_tsn_pv3_no_h < var:oe_tsn_no_h oe_tsn_pv3_no_o > var:oe_tsn_no_o oe_tsn_pv3_no_o < var:oe_tsn_no_o } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_pv_miss add = 1 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 4 }
        oe_tsn_cache_issue_4 = yes
        change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_pv_n add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { oe_tsn_pv4_yes_c > var:oe_tsn_yes_c oe_tsn_pv4_yes_c < var:oe_tsn_yes_c oe_tsn_pv4_yes_t > var:oe_tsn_yes_t oe_tsn_pv4_yes_t < var:oe_tsn_yes_t oe_tsn_pv4_yes_h > var:oe_tsn_yes_h oe_tsn_pv4_yes_h < var:oe_tsn_yes_h oe_tsn_pv4_yes_o > var:oe_tsn_yes_o oe_tsn_pv4_yes_o < var:oe_tsn_yes_o oe_tsn_pv4_no_c > var:oe_tsn_no_c oe_tsn_pv4_no_c < var:oe_tsn_no_c oe_tsn_pv4_no_t > var:oe_tsn_no_t oe_tsn_pv4_no_t < var:oe_tsn_no_t oe_tsn_pv4_no_h > var:oe_tsn_no_h oe_tsn_pv4_no_h < var:oe_tsn_no_h oe_tsn_pv4_no_o > var:oe_tsn_no_o oe_tsn_pv4_no_o < var:oe_tsn_no_o } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_pv_miss add = 1 }
        }
    }
}

# Test page helper: refreshes cache cleanly without runtime debug_log spam.
oe_tsn_pv_log = {
    oe_tsn_refresh_preview_cache = yes
}
